plan: Deep-copy the authored recipe on entry so adapt never mutates inputs and print_original can return authored_text byte-for-byte.
Rescale every ingredient quantity (top-level and per-component) by target_yield / original_yield using exact Fraction arithmetic, then set the recipe yield to the target.
Rank the catalog once by (priority, catalog index) so the lowest numeric priority wins and authored catalog order deterministically breaks ties.

Sweep ingredient lists: for each ingredient whose name is excluded, resolve it via the highest-ranked matching catalog choice, rewriting name, quantity (via quantity_factor), unit, and preparation in place.
Apply each choice's wording_changes as old->new replacements across the instruction strings, warn if the old text is absent, and apply equipment_add/equipment_remove to a working equipment set.
Append additional_ingredients (yield-scaled) to the ingredient list and subject them to the same exclusion check and catalog resolution, enabling chained adaptations.
Detect chains that revisit a name using a per-chain visited set, emitting 'substitution cycle involving NAME'; emit 'no substitution for NAME' when the catalog has no entry.

Accumulate reasons in a set without short-circuiting so every independently applicable failure is reported; validate equipment against available_equipment only after all substitutions so additions/removals are respected.

Drop optional components whose adaptation fails, with a warning, instead of failing the whole recipe; compensate any substitution-driven yield_factor so the final recipe lands exactly on the target yield.
Return {possible, recipe (equipment sorted, or null), choices in application order, sorted warnings, sorted reasons}; include a __main__ acceptance suite covering all seven contract scenarios.
mechanisms: input deep-copy for immutability and exact original preservation
single (priority, index) catalog ranking for deterministic choice
in-place ingredient rewrite driven by catalog result fields
global instruction-string rewriting from wording_changes pairs
working equipment set with post-substitution availability check
chained resolution of replacements and additional ingredients
visited-name set per chain for cycle detection
non-short-circuiting reason accumulation with sorted output
yield-drift compensation to hold the target yield
